label: Ceasefires Currently in Force
contestNote: AUG 24 status — Gaza: nominally holding since Oct 2025 but near-daily strikes continue; Aug 23 strikes killed 3 more (incl. a 4-year-old) and Netanyahu/Katz threatened to 'intensify strikes' and order new evacuations over kite/balloon launches from Gaza, which Hamas dismissed as 'children's toys' and called a fabricated pretext undermining the ceasefire framework. Lebanon: Jun 26 Washington framework signed; 7th round Rome talks (Aug 4-6) produced a reported verification-country shortlist, but a Lebanese official denied Aug 13 that any such shortlist was agreed; Aug 20 US Treasury sanctions on a Hezbollah cash-smuggling network and re-designation of Hezbollah as an Iranian-Qods-Force proxy add fresh pressure on the disarmament sequencing dispute ahead of the next round in early Sep. Iran: Jun 17 Islamabad MOU's 60-day window EXPIRED Aug 17 with no comprehensive deal; Aug 20 Trump announced an 'economic D-Day,' and Aug 24 Treasury Secretary Bessent moved to unveil the sanctions package itself — new secondary sanctions targeting China, Turkey and India as Iran's main oil-sanctions-evasion outlets — with Iran's security chief vowing not to yield and the rial hitting a record low; no new talks announced. Yemen: 2022 UN truce framework under its worst strain since 2022 — Grundberg warned the UN Security Council Aug 13 that Yemen faces its greatest risk of renewed large-scale war since the 2022 truce. Ethiopia: worst breach yet of 2022 Pretoria agreement, fighting resumed near Sheraro Aug 1, with reports of de-escalation by Aug 2 but no formal reaffirmation of the ceasefire. Colombia: De la Espriella inaugurated Aug 7, formally winding down 'Total Peace' and launching a 90-day offensive; former combatants await word on prior commitments. DRC-Rwanda: Doha track roadmap agreed Aug 23 after 5 days of Swiss-hosted talks (Aug 17-21) with US/Qatar/Togo/Switzerland/AU present — first real Doha-track progress in months, alongside the still-stalled Washington Accords track. Venezuela: government-opposition talks concluded a first round Aug 12 with judicial-reform and frozen-funds agreements; 1,046+ prisoners freed as of Aug 15. Ukraine: no ceasefire; Russia's Ryabkov said Aug 21 Moscow is open to 'new ideas' only if they match Putin's preconditions; Witkoff/Kushner postponed their planned first Kyiv visit Aug 24 amid intensified Russian strikes; POW-exchange channel remains the only functioning track. Sudan: Burhan pledged national-dialogue immunity Aug 15; AU Peace and Security Council delegation visited Khartoum Aug 15-16, PM Al-Ta'aishi urged the AU toward impartiality Aug 20, and Khartoum-Riyadh formed a new bilateral coordination council.
deltaNote: Ethiopia Pretoria agreement breach (Aug 1), Yemen truce framework at gravest strain since 2022 (Aug 6-7), and the Iran Islamabad MOU's 60-day window expiring without a deal (Aug 17), followed by the Aug 20-24 US-Iran sanctions escalation, all pressure the 'in force' count; net -2 vs Jun 7 baseline, partly offset by Lebanon framework formalization (Jun 26), Gaza disarmament-mechanism agreement (Aug 17) and the Aug 23 DRC-M23 Doha roadmap

Yemen 2022 truce framework at gravest risk of full collapse since inception — Grundberg told the UN Security Council Aug 13 that Yemen faces its greatest risk of renewed large-scale conflict since the April 2022 truce. Colombia Total Peace effectively wound down by the De la Espriella administration (inaugurated Aug 7), which launched a 90-day offensive against armed groups. Sudan Boulos-plan talks remain stalled — SAF/RSF gave incompatible responses (Jul 12-14) — though Burhan's Aug 15 national-dialogue immunity pledge, the Aug 15-16 AU Peace and Security Council Khartoum visit, and the new Aug 20 Khartoum-Riyadh coordination council offer an alternative track. Lebanon-Israel verification-mechanism track complicated by Beirut's Aug 13 denial that any country shortlist was agreed, and further pressured by Aug 20 US sanctions on Hezbollah's financing network. Ukraine's Witkoff/Kushner shuttle track hit a further delay Aug 24 (postponed first Kyiv visit amid Russian strikes), though DRC-Rwanda's Doha track posted its first real progress in months (Aug 23 roadmap agreement) as a partial offset.
